— 200 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Portal successfully updated the specified account group.
— 403
Returned if you do not have permissions to update the specified account group. For more information,
see Permissions.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified account group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
